page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a-nps1.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at a clock speed of 2.55 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core capabilities, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance ranking in the top 25 percent. Multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench scores align with the middle 50 percent average. Memory performance is mixed; while the Passmark memory score is strong, large-block uncached memory write bandwidth is relatively weak, falling into the bottom 25 percent at 19.13 GB/sec. Cryptographic and integer operations are supported by hardware-accelerated instructions such as AES, VAES, and SHA_NI.

This instance delivers a balanced resource density suitable for general-purpose workloads, enterprise applications, and medium-scale web serving. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention, making it a reliable choice for database operations and multi-threaded decompression tasks.
